$comment: Provisional format until phase 4.4 (kui-tooling parity) defines the schema. One record per component deliberately absent from a sibling repo.

exceptions.name: SchemaForm
exceptions.reason: New in phase 9 (9.10, OD-16), no counterpart. kui-ejs deliberately reverted FormBuilder, so no schema form is added there without a scope decision; KUInative has no form-builder surface. Source of truth for next-boilerplate's FieldSchema, vendored back from here.

exceptions.name: ContributionBoundary
exceptions.reason: A React error boundary isolates contributed UI at render time (next-boilerplate phase 37). kui-ejs renders on the server, so there is no client render to isolate: a failing contribution is caught by the host route and rendered as the UnavailableContribution partial, which both repos have. KUInative keeps an equivalent private to TabGroup (isolate) and exports none until a native host needs one.

exceptions.name: WidgetKit: 3D model kind
exceptions.reason: kui-ejs draws every WidgetKit kind except viewer.model (three.js, drawn client-side with no server-rendered equivalent). The kinds whose view is a pure function of its model are compared as normalised HTML (tests/parity/golden.json); the client-drawn ones (chart.line / area / bar / pie / scatter / histogram, heatmap, map, control.button / switch / slider / setpoint, content.video) are compared as models (tests/parity/model-golden.json) and by mapping tests on what the ui partials are handed.

exceptions.name: WidgetBoard, WidgetSettingsEditor, previews, localize
exceptions.reason: The editing surface (board grid in edit mode, the settings editor, layout thumbnails, template localisation) is a React application built on SchemaForm, which is itself react-only (see schema-form). A server-rendered or native host draws placements; the dashboard editor lives in the host app (next-boilerplate).

exceptions.name: ConditionalShell, GoogleAnalytics
exceptions.reason: Next.js route-level pieces (path-dependent shell, analytics script component): kui-ejs renders its layout per route in Express, so there is nothing to port. Deliberate since ADR 0003.

exceptions.name: EmptyErrorState, NotFoundPage
exceptions.reason: Naming alias: kui-ejs ships the same states as ErrorState, NoAccessState and NotFoundState (modules/app).

exceptions.name: FormBuilder, Gantt
exceptions.reason: kui-ejs shipped both and deliberately reverted them ("moved out of scope" commits). Do not re-add without deciding scope first (ADR 0003, kui-ejs AGENTS.md).

exceptions.name: RulesetEditor
exceptions.reason: The IoT rule canvas belongs to the iot vertical, which is react-only by design (ADR 0003); kui-ejs carries no iot vertical.

exceptions.name: EntityAliases
exceptions.reason: The dashboard alias editor (next-boilerplate dashboard phase 36.4, E36-11): aliases dialog, alias dialog, entity filter form and alias picker are board-editor surfaces, and kui-ejs and KUInative have no board editor. The toolbar entity select (AliasEntitySelect) follows the param bar's parity (NB phase 35 E12) and gets sibling mirrors when a server-rendered or native board viewer needs it (NB 36.9).

exceptions.name: Virtual, lazy, Toast.store
exceptions.reason: Not components: a windowing hook (useVirtualList), a React.lazy helper and a zustand store. kui-ejs draws its windowing inside the partials that need it (TraceWaterfall, LogViewer) and has Toast.ejs with its own runtime.

exceptions.name: Application layer (everything under modules/app but WidgetKit)
exceptions.reason: KUInative README: the heavier kui-react layers (modules/domains, modules/app) are intentionally omitted from the minimal base and are added the same way when a native screen needs them. modules/app/WidgetKit is the first app-layer pattern there (wave 1 kinds). The other patterns are web shells and page-level organisms with no native consumer yet.

exceptions.name: ui components with no native counterpart yet
exceptions.reason: Not created in KUInative until a native screen needs them (the rule of docs/phases/09 and 10: a component absent from a sibling is not created there, and gets a record here). The table family (DataTable, AdvancedDataTable, ServerDataTable), CodeEditor, TimeWindowPicker / TimeWindowSelect, DateRangePicker are web interaction surfaces; the observability and AI pieces (LogViewer, TraceWaterfall, ServiceMap, ConversationTimeline, DayBarChart, Evidence, AiHumanDraftEditor, InlineEditList, LocaleSwitcher) were added to kui-react on 2026-10-18 for the next-boilerplate observability platform. Virtual, lazy and Toast.store are React modules, not components.

exceptions.name: WidgetKit: 3D model kind not drawn natively
exceptions.reason: KUInative draws every WidgetKit kind except viewer.model (three.js). Kinds drawn from the pure models: stat.value, stat.sparkline, stat.attributes, state, progress, gauge, data.table, data.feed, content.markdown, content.image, content.links, the charts, heatmap, map, the four control kinds and content.video; content.embed is an Open button, not a frame (react-native-webview is not a dependency). Compared as visible text (tests/parity) and as models (model-golden.json).
